title: Larkspur Credit Cards Cash Back Program Terms
content:
These program terms cover how cash back is earned, taken back, redeemed and forfeited on the Larkspur Credit Cards.

## Earning

Cash back is earned on each purchase at the card's rate for the purchase's rewards category, rounded to the cent. The categories are grocery, dining, gas and travel. The base rate applies to any other purchase and to foreign purchases.

Cash advances, balance transfers, fees and interest earn nothing.

| Line posted to the card | Cash back earned |
|---|---|
| Grocery, dining, gas or travel purchase | The card's rate for that category |
| Any other purchase | The card's base rate |
| Foreign purchase | The card's base rate |
| Cash advance, balance transfer, fee or interest | None |

## Merchant credits

A merchant credit posts against the one purchase it refunds. It reduces the balance on its posting date and is not a payment toward the minimum payment due.

A merchant credit takes back the cash back earned on the credited amount at the rate of the original purchase.

The take-back is tied to that merchant credit. One rewards adjustment stands per merchant credit, and it is identified from the card's posted entries by the merchant credit it relates to.

## Redemption

Rewards can be redeemed as a statement credit or a deposit to a verified linked bank account, in amounts of at least the card's minimum redemption, while the account is active.

## Forfeiture

Unredeemed rewards are forfeited when the account is closed or charged off. The forfeiture is recorded as one adjustment at closing.

The category rates and minimum redemption of each card are those in the card's product terms.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical rate

The 5 percent rate below is invented for the arithmetic. It is not the rate of any Larkspur card.

- **Earning.** A dining purchase of 200.00 on a card paying 5 percent for dining earns 10.00. A purchase of 33.33 at 5 percent gives 1.6665, which rounds to the cent as 1.67.
- **Partial refund.** A merchant credit of 40.00 later posts against the 200.00 purchase. The cash back taken back is 5 percent of 40.00, that is 2.00. It is taken at the rate of the original purchase.
- **Forfeiture.** An account closes holding 12.00 of unredeemed rewards. One adjustment of 12.00 is recorded at closing.
